description: This file contains a localization module for the Select2 jQuery plugin, providing Portuguese translations for various UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should delete extra characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items selectable.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while searching.
